hero.description: Centered single-column hero on cream canvas with tight editorial headline, soft subtitle, dark inset CTA, ghost secondary CTA, and optional prompt/input visual.
Premium editorial hero with floating pill nav and a large 40px-radius media frame or video/image stadium below headline copy.
Single dark indigo hero island on warm paper canvas with white headline, blue CTA, secondary white pill, and small playful sticker accents.
White/paper productivity hero with large tight Inter headline, blue primary pill, secondary demo CTA, and a rounded product screenshot panel.
Dark-gold high-conversion hero inspired by the PDF capture: transformation headline, proof chips, speaker/wealth visual, and immediate gold CTA or compact lead form.
Long-form direct-response hero with eyebrow, big promise headline, emotional subhead, VSL/media placeholder, red CTA, and short proof/urgency line.

navigation.description: Clean horizontal nav on cream canvas with understated links and dark inset CTA.
White floating nav pill 24px below top, rounded 999px, soft shadow, logo left, airy links, circular search/menu action.
Slim white sticky nav with utility CTA, product/menu links, and restrained blue action.
Dark transparent or solid nav with warm gold CTA, compact links, and high-contrast event/brand mark.
Minimal long-form sales nav with logo, one primary red CTA, and optional sticky mobile bottom CTA instead of dense menu links.

feature.description: 2-3 column cream cards with #eceae4 borders, 12px radius, no shadow, warm humanist copy.
Large AI-style prompt input area with suggestion pills, soft warm borders, and pill icon toggles.
Asymmetric circular service portraits with white satellite CTA buttons and thin orange orbital arcs.
Cream-on-cream oversized ghost headline behind circular or pill media, used for premium editorial pacing.
White cards on warm paper canvas with hairline borders, 12px radius, tight Inter headings, and blue links.
Quiet feature cards with small decorative sticker-color icons or dots; sticker colors never become CTAs.
Story-led pain section that names old money beliefs, missed opportunities, and the need for a new wealth operating system.
Dark premium benefit cards with gold borders, bold benefit headlines, short proof-oriented copy, and alternating emphasis cards.
Speaker/mentor authority section with portrait, credential chips, signature lesson bullets, and a gold CTA.
Long-form story section that expands the reader's problem, agitates hidden costs, and uses highlighted phrases to build urgency.
Teaching-style section that reframes the core belief, alternating cream narrative panels with dark quote/warning boxes.

proof.description: Large warm-neutral metric row with 48px+ numbers, muted labels, generous spacing.
Large pill/stadium carousel cards with image-led stories, white chips, and ink CTA buttons.
Rounded product screenshot frame or white document panel with hairline border and soft layered elevation.
Gallery of bordered screenshot cards on cream background with calm hover border darkening.
Stacked testimonials, attendee numbers, media/proof chips, or before-after belief shifts on dark-gold surfaces.
Long-form proof wall with screenshots/testimonials, numbered outcomes, short case stories, and repeated CTA after proof.

offer.description: Warm bordered offer cards with dark inset CTA and compact benefit rows.
Stadium/pill ticket block with strong ink CTA, circular speaker/venue imagery, and sparse details.
Notion-like pricing cards: white surfaces, warm paper featured tier, utility buttons, hairline dividers.
High-ticket/event offer block with deadline, bonuses, limited seats, gold CTA, and bright cream registration form card.
Direct-response offer stack with core offer, bonuses, value anchors, guarantee/risk reversal, deadline, and red CTA.
FAQ section framed as objection handling, using direct questions and persuasive answers before the final CTA.

form.description: Cream form with #eceae4 borders, 6px inputs, dark inset submit button, and understated helper text.
Sparse form with pill inputs/selectors and ink 20px-radius submit CTA on lifted cream or white surface.
White form card on paper canvas with tight 4px inputs, blue pill submit, and simple field hierarchy.
Cream form card on a dark section with rounded inputs, black text, gold submit button, and short trust/privacy note.
White or cream lead form with bold labels, 10px inputs, red submit button, urgency note, and privacy reassurance.

cta.description: Cream final CTA with large tight headline, dark inset CTA, and ghost secondary action.
Warm-black footer CTA with large conversational headline and 4-column link/support grid.
Warm paper footer with compact link columns, muted text, and restrained blue links.
Dark footer with gold divider, repeated final CTA, compact contact links, and financial-risk/legal disclaimer.
Final long-form conversion block with condensed promise, red CTA/form, urgency, guarantee note, and compact legal footer.

selectionRules: Pick one design preset per landing page and keep all structural colors/radii consistent.
Do not mix Mastercard orange arcs with Notion sticker accents or Lovable cream button shadows on the same page.
Use a maximum of one dark/inverted section per page unless the selected preset explicitly calls for a dark footer.
If the landing page is finance/event/premium offline, prefer mastercard-orbit-editorial.
If the landing page is software/course/productivity, prefer notion-paper-productivity or lovable-warm-builder.
If the current generated page resembles the existing trading pages, avoid dark hero + amber CTA and choose one of these new variants.
If the reference is a wealth, prosperity, money mindset, or high-ticket finance event page, use danh-thuc-su-giau-co-capture and follow its PDF source for section order.
If the reference is a long Vietnamese SSS/VSL/direct-response sales page, use sss-long-vn-capture and preserve the long narrative arc with repeated CTAs.
